展开状态由应用同步；长菜单在面板内滚动，方向键自动跳过禁用项。上方展开会保留相同: The application synchronizes open state. Long menus scroll internally, and arrow keys skip disabled items. Upward opening preserves the same transition.
展开使用 160ms 淡入、6px 位移与 0.98 → 1 缩放。支持方向键、: Opening uses a 160ms fade, 6px offset, and 0.98-to-1 scale. Supports arrow keys, Home/End, typeahead, and Escape. Tab closes the menu and continues page navigation. Respects reduced motion.
菜单以 160ms 淡入、轻微位移和缩放展开；系统开启减少动态效果时关闭过渡。: Menus open with a 160ms fade, subtle offset, and scale. Transitions are disabled for reduced motion.
加载、空数据与固定表头: Loading, empty data, and sticky headers
在本地切换加载和空数据状态，体验紧凑行高、滚动与固定表头；此示例不请求后端。: Toggle local loading and empty states to explore compact rows, scrolling, and sticky headers. No backend requests are made.
可用选项仍支持键盘切换；整组禁用时保留选中状态。: Available options retain keyboard navigation. Disabling the group preserves its selection.
展开空数据可查看提示；输入不匹配关键词可查看搜索空结果。: Open the empty selector to view its message, or enter an unmatched search to view the no-results state.
零页、单页与页码边界: Zero pages, one page, and boundaries
没有数据时禁用两个方向；到达首尾页后禁用相应按钮。: Both directions are disabled without data. The corresponding navigation button is disabled at each boundary.
用 disabled 防止重复提交，配合 aria-busy 和结果文字提供反馈: Use disabled to prevent duplicate submission, with aria-busy and result text for feedback. The save request is simulated locally.
校验逻辑由应用控制。错误文字与 aria-describedby 关联；只读内容: The application controls validation. aria-describedby connects error text; read-only content remains selectable and copyable.
禁用状态保留当前值，并在旁边说明无法修改的原因。: Disabled controls preserve their value and explain why editing is unavailable.
填写后重新检查，错误会随有效内容消失；error 的显示优先于 descript: Validation is checked again after editing. Valid input clears the error; error takes priority over description.
危险操作通过 danger 属性表达。示例中请明确操作对象和后果。: Use danger for destructive actions. Clearly explain the affected item and consequences.
零进度、完成与总量未知: Zero progress, completion, and unknown totals
总量未知时省略 value，不用 0% 表示加载中。: Omit value when the total is unknown. Do not use 0% to represent indeterminate loading.
空数据、加载与请求失败: Empty data, loading, and request failure
切换列表状态，体验创建和重试操作；加载时保留内容结构。: Switch list states to try creation and retry actions. Loading preserves the content structure.
图片加载失败后回退到姓名首字母，辅助技术仍读取完整姓名。: Failed images fall back to initials. Assistive technology still reads the full name.
defaultValue 只在挂载时读取；程序修改请使用 ref.setText: defaultValue is read only on mount. Use ref.setText or clear for programmatic changes. The host supplies message submission and file uploads.
必须放在 ModelOptionsProvider 内，且在浏览器挂载后渲染。: Place this component inside ModelOptionsProvider and render it after mounting in the browser.
用量达到警告阈值时改变颜色；超过容量与容量未知分别处理。: The color changes at the warning threshold. Exceeded and unknown capacity are handled separately.
状态与工具执行由宿主管理。点击重试，再模拟成功或失败。: The host manages tool execution and state. Retry, then simulate success or failure.
提交期间暂时禁用操作。可关闭“模拟提交失败”后重试，查看已允许状态。: Actions are temporarily disabled during submission. Turn off the simulated failure and retry to see the approved state.
准备就绪的文件才能打开；失败项可移除；禁用项保留可读信息。: Only ready files can be opened. Failed items can be removed; disabled items remain readable.
留空提交会显示组件内的错误提示；关闭模板时保留已填写的内容。: Submitting empty required values displays validation errors. Disabling the template preserves entered values.
新用户与搜索空结果: New users and empty search results
新建会话后搜索一个不匹配的关键词，查看不同的空状态说明。筛选逻辑在示例中实现。: Create a conversation, then search for an unmatched term to explore empty states. Filtering is implemented in the example.
恢复期间阻止重复操作；完成后显示结果并禁用当前检查点。: Repeated restoration is blocked while pending. Completion displays the result and disables the current checkpoint.
重新授权后模拟连接成功。权限说明只在已连接时展示。: Reauthorization simulates a successful connection. Granted permissions appear only while connected.
组件内部展示的 React 内容。: React content rendered inside the component.
语义颜色，继承当前深色或浅色主题。: Semantic color that follows the current dark or light theme.
自定义图标，建议传入尺寸明确的 React 元素。: Custom icon; use a React element with an explicit size.
将标签内容渲染为可切换选中的按钮。: Render the tag content as a selectable toggle button.
复选框或开关的当前受控选中状态。: Controlled checked state for a checkbox or switch.
非受控模式的初始选中状态。: Initial checked state in uncontrolled mode.
请求切换选中状态；受控模式下同步更新 checked。: Request a selection change; update checked in controlled mode.
禁用交互，保留内容可读。: Disable interaction while keeping the content readable.
显示独立关闭按钮，不与选择按钮嵌套。: Show a separate close button without nesting it inside the selection button.
关闭按钮的可访问名称。: Accessible name for the close button.
关闭请求；调用 event.preventDefault() 可以阻止关闭。: Close request. Call event.preventDefault() to prevent dismissal.
受控可见状态；关闭后仍保留退场动画。: Controlled visibility, retaining the exit animation when closed.
退场动画完成后调用，可在这里从列表移除标签。: Called after the exit animation; remove the tag from its array here.
附加在组件根节点上的样式类名。: Additional CSS class on the root element.
根节点的内联样式。: Inline styles for the root element.
DOM 标识，可与 label 的 htmlFor 关联。: DOM identifier that can be referenced by a label's htmlFor.
控件的辅助技术名称；没有可见标签时应提供。: Accessible name; provide one when there is no visible label.
描述或错误提示元素的 id，可用空格连接多个 id。: IDs of description or error elements, separated by spaces.
数量或短文字；无效数字不显示，负数按 0 处理。: Count or short text. Invalid numbers are hidden; negative numbers become zero.
超过该值显示 n+；辅助技术仍读取实际数量。: Counts above this value display n+; assistive technology still reads the actual count.
计数为 0 时仍显示。: Show the badge when the count is zero.
仅显示状态点，忽略 count。: Show only a status dot, ignoring count.
可选的状态文字，显示在徽标旁。: Optional status text beside the badge.
徽标的可访问名称，例如“8 条未读消息”。: Accessible badge name, such as “8 unread messages”.
有 children 时将徽标附着于其右上角。: Attach the badge to the top-right corner of children.
附着徽标的横、纵偏移，单位 px。: Horizontal and vertical offsets in pixels.
计数徽标高度：sm 16px，md 18px。: Count badge height: sm is 16px; md is 18px.
标题或控件旁的补充说明。: Supporting text beside the title or control.
语义类型；danger 默认使用 alert，其余使用 status 语义。: Semantic tone. danger defaults to alert; other tones use status.
自定义图标；false 隐藏图标。: Custom icon; false hides the icon.
操作区域，可放入按钮或链接。: Action area for buttons or links.
完成退场后调用，可用于清理列表数据。: Called after exit completes, for example to remove the item from a list.
传给根节点的 ARIA 角色。: ARIA role passed to the root element.
触发按钮的名称；仅图标按钮也必须提供。: Trigger name, required even for an icon-only trigger.
自定义触发按钮内容，不要嵌套按钮或链接。: Custom trigger content. Do not nest buttons or links.
确认回调；返回 Promise 时自动显示加载，成功关闭，失败保留浮层。: Confirmation callback. A Promise enables automatic loading; success closes the panel and failure keeps it open.
取消、Escape、点击外部或再次点击触发按钮时调用。: Called for Cancel, Escape, outside clicks, or clicking the trigger again.
确认失败回调，方便业务记录错误。: Confirmation failure callback for application error reporting.
危险操作使用红色图标与确认按钮。: Use a red icon and confirm button for a dangerous action.
自定义说明图标；false 隐藏。: Custom description icon; false hides it.
外部业务控制的加载状态；自动 Promise 加载仍然生效。: Loading state controlled by the application; automatic Promise loading still applies.
非受控模式的初始展开状态。: Initial open state in uncontrolled mode.
展开或关闭时通知应用；受控模式下需同步更新 open。: Called when opening or closing; update open in controlled mode.
auto 优先向下，空间不足时向上。: auto prefers below and flips above when space is limited.
浮层与按钮的起始边或结束边对齐。: Align the overlay to the start or end of its trigger.
浮层层级，在弹窗中可覆盖。: Overlay stacking level; override it when used inside a dialog.
触发按钮的视觉权重。: Visual weight of the trigger button.
确认面板的样式，可覆盖宽度等外观。: Confirmation panel styles, including custom width.
触发按钮与菜单的名称。: Accessible name for the trigger and menu.
操作项与分隔线；id 在同一菜单内唯一。空数组会禁用触发按钮。: Actions and separators with unique IDs. An empty array disables the trigger.
自定义按钮内容，例如图标；不要嵌套按钮或链接。未传时显示 label。: Custom trigger content, such as an icon. Do not nest buttons or links. Falls back to label.
菜单与按钮的左边或右边对齐；靠近视口边缘时自动避让。: Align to the trigger's start or end; automatically avoid viewport edges.
展开方向；auto 优先向下，空间不足时向上。: Opening direction. auto prefers below and flips above if needed.
是否显示随展开状态旋转的箭头。: Show an arrow that rotates with the open state.
菜单层级；在更高层级的弹窗中使用时可覆盖。: Menu stacking level; override it for higher-level dialogs.
固定在抽屉底部的操作区域。: Action area fixed to the bottom of the drawer.
抽屉从哪个方向进入。: Direction from which the drawer enters.
侧边抽屉宽度或上下抽屉高度档位。: Width preset for side drawers or height preset for top/bottom drawers.
点击遮罩是否请求关闭；Escape 仍可关闭。: Whether clicking the backdrop requests closing. Escape remains available.
控件名称；用于可见标签或辅助技术。: Control name for a visible label or assistive technology.
可选项；每项的值、标签和可选配置见类型定义。: Available options. See the type definition for values, labels, and configuration.
当前受控值；与变化回调配合更新。: Current controlled value; update it through the change callback.
非受控模式的初始值；挂载后修改不会覆盖当前值。: Initial uncontrolled value. Changes after mounting do not replace the current value.
值变化时通知应用；受控模式下需同步更新 value。: Called when the value changes; update value in controlled mode.
原生单选组的表单字段名；未传时自动生成，避免不同实例互相影响。: Native radio group field name. Generated automatically when omitted to isolate instances.
树节点数组；id 在树内唯一，children 定义子节点，disabled 禁: Tree nodes with unique IDs. children defines nested nodes; disabled prevents selection.
受控展开节点 id 列表。: Controlled array of expanded node IDs.
非受控模式下初始展开的节点 id。: Initially expanded node IDs in uncontrolled mode.
展开节点变化时返回完整 id 列表。: Returns the full array of expanded IDs after changes.
没有输入内容时显示的提示文字。: Placeholder shown when the input is empty.
没有可显示结果时的提示文字。: Message displayed when there are no results.
当前页码，从 1 开始；渲染时限制在有效页码范围。: Current page, starting at 1 and clamped to the valid range.
总页数；0 或无效值时没有可选页，两侧按钮均禁用。: Total pages. Zero or invalid values disable both navigation directions.
选择有效页码时返回新页码，由应用更新 page。: Returns a selected valid page; the application updates page.
视觉权重：primary 主操作、secondary 次操作、quiet 轻量操: Visual weight: primary, secondary, quiet, or danger. Combine an icon, disabled, and aria-busy for loading states.
鼠标点击或键盘激活时触发。: Called on pointer clicks or keyboard activation.
向辅助技术声明内容正在更新；不会自动禁用控件。: Announce updates to assistive technology; does not disable the control.
访问底层 DOM 元素的 React ref。: React ref for the underlying DOM element.
受控输入内容；在 onChange 中读取 event.target.value: Controlled input text. Read event.target.value in onChange and update the value.
原生输入事件；通过 event.target.value 读取文本。: Native input event; read text through event.target.value.
只读；允许聚焦和复制，不允许用户编辑。: Read-only content can be focused and copied, but not edited.
表单提交时使用的字段名。: Field name used in form submission.
挂载时自动聚焦，请避免多个控件同时使用。: Focus automatically on mount. Avoid enabling it on multiple controls.
控件失去焦点时触发。: Called when the control loses focus.
声明输入无效；表单校验与错误文字由应用提供。: Mark the input invalid. The application supplies validation and error text.
浏览器自动填充提示，例如 name、email 或 off。: Browser autofill hint, such as name, email, or off.
值变化时通知应用；参数类型见左侧类型定义。: Called when the value changes. See the type definition for callback arguments.
至少提供一个选项；value 不匹配时显示第一项。支持键盘方向键、Home /: Provide at least one option. An unmatched value displays the first option. Supports arrows, Home/End, and typeahead.
ok 使用成功色状态点；muted 使用弱化状态点。: ok uses a success-colored dot; muted uses a subdued dot.
提供时显示右上角关闭按钮；点击后通知应用。: Shows a close button in the top-right corner when provided.
拖动或键盘调整时的步长。: Step size for dragging or keyboard adjustment.
右侧数值输入框下限；可与滑块范围不同。: Minimum value for the numeric input; may differ from the slider range.
右侧数值输入框上限；可与滑块范围不同。: Maximum value for the numeric input; may differ from the slider range.
拖动或编辑过程中的临时值；apply 表示应用方式。: Temporary value while dragging or editing. apply describes the application mode.
松开或确认输入后提交最终值；由应用更新 value。: Commit the final value after release or confirmation; the application updates value.
取消编辑时恢复预览前的值。: Restore the value from before preview when editing is cancelled.
显示半选状态并设置 aria-checked=mixed；实际选中值仍由 che: Show a mixed state with aria-checked=mixed; checked still controls the actual selection.
选择变化后返回 boolean，由应用更新 checked。: Return the new boolean selection; the application updates checked.
表单提交值；不表示选中状态。: Form submission value, independent of the checked state.
校验错误文字；优先于 description 显示，并设置 aria-inval: Validation error. Takes priority over description and sets aria-invalid.
文本区域初始可见行数。: Initial number of visible text rows.
拖动或输入过程中的临时值；apply 表示应用方式。: Temporary value while dragging or typing. apply describes the application mode.
键盘或拖动调整的步长。: Step size for keyboard or drag adjustments.
允许输入的最小值；不传则不限制下限。: Minimum input value. Omit for no lower bound.
允许输入的最大值；不传则不限制上限。: Maximum input value. Omit for no upper bound.
选择字体后返回字体族名称，由应用更新 value。: Return the chosen font family; the application updates value.
确认按钮文字；默认使用当前语言的确认文案。: Confirm button text, defaulting to the current locale's confirmation label.
当前语言的确认文案: Confirmation label for the current locale
取消按钮文字；默认使用当前语言的取消文案。: Cancel button text, defaulting to the current locale's cancellation label.
当前语言的取消文案: Cancellation label for the current locale
将确认按钮显示为危险操作样式。: Style the confirm button as a dangerous action.
点击额外操作按钮时触发；需同时提供 altLabel。: Called for the extra action; also provide altLabel.
确认操作的回调；业务完成后由应用关闭弹窗。: Confirmation callback. The application closes the dialog after completing its work.
取消、Escape、关闭按钮或点击遮罩时触发。: Called for Cancel, Escape, the close button, or backdrop clicks.
请求关闭，由应用更新可见状态。: Request closing; the application updates visibility.
设置页面定义；包含唯一 id、分组、标题、图标和内容。: Settings page definitions with unique IDs, groups, titles, icons, and content.
初始页面 id；未指定时使用第一页。: Initial page ID; defaults to the first page.
侧栏底部的自定义内容。: Custom content at the bottom of the sidebar.
浮层触发元素，需能接收组件注入的 ref 和事件。: Overlay trigger that can receive the injected ref and event handlers.
优先在上方或下方显示；auto 根据可用空间决定。: Prefer above or below; auto chooses based on available space.
菜单锚点的视口纵坐标，单位 px；与 x 一起传入。: Vertical viewport coordinate of the menu anchor in pixels; provide it with x.
菜单项、分隔线和子菜单；操作由各项 onSelect 处理。: Menu actions, separators, and submenus. Each item handles actions through onSelect.
useToast().current 返回的提示对象；null 时隐藏。: Toast object from useToast().current; null hides the toast.
点击主操作时触发。: Called when the primary action is activated.
主操作进行中，禁用主按钮并显示加载状态。: Disable the primary button and display loading while the action is pending.
主操作使用危险色。: Use a danger color for the primary action.
请求收起或忽略此内容，由应用更新状态。: Request dismissal; the application updates the state.
页签定义；value 唯一，content 为面板内容，disabled 禁止选: Tab definitions with unique values, content, and optional disabled states.
路径条目；可提供 href 或 onClick，最后一项表示当前位置。: Breadcrumb entries with href or onClick. The final item marks the current location.
拖动或键盘调整后返回新的面板宽度，单位 px。: Return the new panel width in pixels after a drag or keyboard adjustment.
同一容器中剩余面板必须保留的最小宽度，单位 px。: Minimum width in pixels reserved for the remaining panels in the container.
标题右侧的补充内容或操作。: Supporting content or actions beside the heading.
没有已保存的展开偏好时，是否默认收起。: Start collapsed when no saved expansion preference exists.
当前播放或定位时间，单位 ms。: Current playback or seek time in milliseconds.
选择图层时返回所属片段 id 和图层定位信息。: Return the owning clip ID and layer locator when selecting a layer.
选择片段时返回片段定位信息。: Return the clip locator when selecting a clip.
将操作提示交给宿主展示。: Send notifications to the host application.
已完成的数值；不传或不是有限数值时显示不确定进度。: Completed amount. Omitted or non-finite values display indeterminate progress.
总量；必须大于 0。已知进度会限制在 0%–100%。: Total amount, greater than zero. Known progress is clamped to 0–100%.
在标签旁显示百分比；不确定进度显示“进行中”。: Display a percentage beside the label, or “In progress” for an unknown total.
占位宽度；数字按 px 处理，也可使用 CSS 长度或百分比。: Placeholder width. Numbers use pixels; CSS lengths and percentages are accepted.
占位高度；数字按 px 处理，也可使用 CSS 长度。: Placeholder height. Numbers use pixels; CSS lengths are accepted.
是否播放占位动画；减少动态效果设置优先。: Enable shimmer animation. Reduced-motion preferences take priority.
空状态的操作区域，例如创建或重试按钮。: Empty-state actions, such as Create or Retry.
字幕轨道的状态与操作，包括显示、配置、生成和错误反馈。: Subtitle-track state and actions for visibility, configuration, generation, and errors.
选择变化后返回选中的片段 id 列表。: Return selected clip IDs when the selection changes.
选择转场时返回 key；取消选择时返回 null。: Return the selected transition key, or null when selection is cancelled.
辅助技术名称，同时用于生成缺省头像的首字母。: Accessible name, also used to generate fallback initials.
图片地址；未提供或图片加载失败时退回首字母头像。: Image URL. Missing or failed images fall back to initials.
头像尺寸档位：sm、md、lg。: Avatar size preset: sm, md, or lg.
编辑器中的引用数据，由宿主维护。: Editor references maintained by the host.
触发发送时通知宿主；文本通过 ref 或 onChange 获取。: Notify the host on submission. Read text through the ref or onChange.
编辑区域最大高度，单位 px；超出后内部滚动。: Maximum editor height in pixels, with internal scrolling beyond it.
附加的文件大小、类型或状态说明。: Additional file size, type, or status information.
工具执行活动及状态；列表只负责渲染，不执行工具。: Tool activity and states. The list renders activity without executing tools.
生成列表 React key 时的前缀。: Prefix for generated React list keys.
问题及候选答案；没有选项时允许自由输入。: Question and candidate answers. Allows free-form input when options are absent.
文件改动列表，包括路径、增加与删除行数等。: File changes including paths and added/deleted line counts.
余额与额度状态，实际数据由宿主服务提供。: Balance and quota data supplied by the host service.
请求重命名当前会话；返回持久化操作的 Promise。: Request renaming the current conversation; return a persistence Promise.
字段左侧标记或图标。: Label or icon to the left of the field.
度量类别，决定允许的单位和换算规则。: Metric category that determines permitted units and conversions.
取消当前编辑并恢复预览前的值。: Cancel editing and restore the pre-preview value.
菜单优先在触发器上方或下方展开。: Prefer opening the menu above or below its trigger.
菜单与触发器起始边或结束边对齐。: Align the menu to the trigger's start or end.
已保存的提示引用，包括类型、标签和定位信息。: Saved prompt reference with its type, label, and locator.
显示的作者名；未提供时根据 role 使用默认名称。: Displayed author name. Defaults to the role name.
附加的时间、来源或状态内容。: Additional time, source, or status content.
消息底部的操作区域，可组合 MessageActions。: Message footer actions, such as MessageActions.
操作数组；每项包含 id、标签、图标与 onSelect，可设置 pressed: Action array with IDs, labels, icons, onSelect, and optional pressed/disabled states.
纯文本源码；不会作为 HTML 执行。: Plain-text source code; never executed as HTML.
代码语言名称，仅作标签；语法高亮需提供 renderLine。: Language label. Supply renderLine for syntax highlighting.
非受控模式的初始折叠状态。: Initial collapsed state in uncontrolled mode.
折叠状态变化时触发。: Called when the collapsed state changes.
剪贴板写入失败时触发，参数为 Error。: Called with an Error when clipboard writing fails.
来源的完整 HTTP / HTTPS 链接；其他协议不会生成可访问链接。: Full HTTP/HTTPS source URL. Other protocols do not produce accessible links.
回答总数；没有可切换回答时禁用相应方向。: Total responses. Navigation is disabled when there is no available response.
上一条回答按钮的辅助技术名称。: Accessible name for the previous-response button.
下一条回答按钮的辅助技术名称。: Accessible name for the next-response button.
已使用容量；应为非负有限数值。: Used capacity as a non-negative finite number.
总容量；必须为正有限数值，否则显示未知用量。: Total capacity as a positive finite number; otherwise usage is unknown.
警告阈值，取值 0–1；超过总容量使用危险色。: Warning threshold from 0 to 1. Exceeded capacity uses a danger color.
是否播放思考动效；false 时保留静态文字。: Animate the thinking indicator; false retains static text.
由应用传入当前状态，组件不发起后台任务。: State supplied by the application. The component does not start background tasks.
工具名称，显示在展开标题中。: Tool name displayed in the disclosure heading.
工具输入的文本表示，通常使用 JSON 字符串。: Text representation of tool input, usually JSON.
工具返回内容，可传文本或自定义 React 节点。: Tool output as text or custom React content.
展示给用户的错误信息。: Error message displayed to the user.
有序步骤；每项包含唯一 id、标题、状态及可选说明。: Ordered steps with unique IDs, titles, states, and optional descriptions.
pending 等待决定；submitting 禁用操作；approved /: pending awaits a decision; submitting disables actions; approved/rejected show the result.
提交允许决定；实际授权和执行必须由宿主服务完成。: Submit an approval decision. The host service performs actual authorization and execution.
提交拒绝决定，由宿主更新状态。: Submit a rejection decision; the host updates the state.
ready 可打开；uploading 上传中；error 显示失败。后两种状态: ready allows opening; uploading and error prevent opening the attachment.
请求移除附件；实际列表由应用更新。: Request attachment removal; the application updates its list.
请求打开内容，由应用处理导航或预览。: Request opening content; the application handles navigation or preview.
来源列表；包含 id、标题、可选链接、摘要和来源说明。: Sources with IDs, titles, and optional links, summaries, and source details.
是否显示为当前选中的助手。: Whether this is the selected agent.
用户选择此项时触发。: Called when the user selects this item.
本次运行的指标项，例如时长、调用次数、用量与费用。: Run metrics such as duration, calls, usage, and cost.
成果类型文字，例如文档、图片或代码。: Result type, such as document, image, or code.
成果预览区域的 React 内容。: React content for the result preview.
变量定义；声明名称、标签、必填及占位提示。: Variable definitions with names, labels, required flags, and placeholders.
当前受控变量值，以变量名为键。: Controlled variable values keyed by variable name.
变量编辑时返回更新后的完整值对象。: Return the complete updated values object after editing.
必填变量通过校验后，返回替换变量后的完整提示词。: Return the substituted prompt after required variables pass validation.
会话条目，包含 id、标题及可选摘要、时间与未读状态。: Conversations with IDs, titles, and optional excerpts, timestamps, and unread states.
受控搜索框内容；列表筛选由宿主应用处理。: Controlled search text. The host application filters the list.
提供时显示搜索框，输入后返回新搜索词。: Show a search field when provided; return each updated query.
提供时显示新建按钮，点击后请求创建会话。: Show a creation button when provided; request a new conversation when clicked.
操作进行中；暂时禁用该组件的操作按钮。: Operation in progress; temporarily disable the component's actions.
恢复按钮文字；pending 时显示“恢复中…”。: Restore button text. Displays “Restoring…” while pending.
位于底部附近时自动跟随新内容；用户上滚后停止跟随。: Follow new content near the bottom; stop following when the user scrolls upward.
已格式化的执行频率说明；组件不解析 cron。: Formatted schedule text. The component does not parse cron.
调度使用的时区名称，由应用传入。: Timezone name supplied by the application.
由调度服务提供、已格式化的下次执行时间。: Formatted next-run time supplied by the scheduler.
请求切换启用状态；实际调度由宿主更新。: Request an enabled-state change; the host updates the actual schedule.
实际授予的权限说明列表。: Descriptions of the permissions actually granted.
请求连接或重新授权，由应用执行授权流程。: Request connection or reauthorization; the application performs the authorization flow.
说明为何此时提出建议。: Explain why the suggestion is relevant now.
请求执行建议；由应用处理并维护 pending 状态。: Request executing the suggestion; the application handles it and maintains pending state.
活动事件数组；包含 id、标题、时间及状态。: Activities with IDs, titles, times, and states.
简报标题下的日期或概述。: Date or summary below the briefing title.
简报事项列表；每项包含 id、标题及可选的详情、附加文字和 onSelect 操: Briefing entries with IDs, titles, optional details, metadata, and onSelect actions.
修改当前卡片中的第一个示例，预览与代码会同步更新。: Edit the first example. Preview and code stay in sync.
